First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @pridebikeridehouston the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesgay Social Ride group ride

An LGBTQ+ social ride open to everyone, allies included. Social hour at Varsity Bar at 7, roll out at 7:30, a different bar or restaurant as the midpoint each week. Social pace, 13 mph max, 20 miles tops. No spandex required.
